ruleText.zh-CN: 硕士共需 120 ECTS，四个学期，每学期 30 ECTS。硕士论文占 30 ECTS（书面论文 27 + 答辩 3）。
ruleText.en: The master requires 120 ECTS across four semesters, 30 per semester. The master thesis accounts for 30 ECTS (27 written + 3 defence).

name.zh-CN: 必修：基础课与定位模块
name.en: Mandatory: foundation lectures and orientation modules

ruleText.zh-CN: 两门基础课各 7.5 ECTS（90 分钟笔试），四个定位模块各 7.5 ECTS，合计 45 ECTS。
ruleText.en: Two foundation lectures at 7.5 ECTS each (90-minute written exam) and four orientation modules at 7.5 ECTS each, 45 ECTS in total.

ruleText.zh-CN: 研究模块 20 ECTS，考核形式为 45 分钟口试。
ruleText.en: Research module worth 20 ECTS, assessed by a 45-minute oral examination.

name.zh-CN: 选修：三选一实习或语言模块
name.en: Elective: one of three internship or language modules

ruleText.zh-CN: 校外实习、校内实习、UNIcert III 英语三者中必选其一，15 ECTS。校外实习须在开始前经生物系教授批准，实习结束后由同一位教授评定成绩。
ruleText.en: Exactly one of external internship, internal internship, or UNIcert III English must be taken, 15 ECTS. An external internship needs approval from a Biology Department professor beforehand, and the same professor assesses it afterwards.

name.zh-CN: 关键能力、学术演讲与硕士论文
name.en: Key qualifications, scientific presentations and master thesis

ruleText.zh-CN: 关键能力 5 ECTS，学术演讲 5 ECTS，硕士论文 30 ECTS，合计 40 ECTS。关键能力可从 FAU 全部关键能力模块中选。
ruleText.en: Key qualifications 5 ECTS, scientific presentations 5 ECTS, master thesis 30 ECTS, 40 ECTS in total. Key qualifications may be chosen from the full FAU catalogue.

ruleText.zh-CN: 硕士共需 120 ECTS，四个学期。结构为：统计模块 5 ECTS + 两个模块组（30 与 35 ECTS）+ 深化模块 20 ECTS + 硕士论文 30 ECTS。
ruleText.en: The master requires 120 ECTS across four semesters: statistics 5 ECTS, two module groups (30 and 35 ECTS), advanced module 20 ECTS, and master thesis 30 ECTS.

ruleText.zh-CN: 从三个模块组中选两个：生物数学建模与系统生物学、生物成像与生物物理、生物结构与过程。一组修 30 ECTS，另一组修 35 ECTS。模块组选择在报名第一门考试时确定，之后不可更改。
ruleText.en: Choose two of three module groups: Mathematical Modelling and Systems Biology, Bioimaging and Biophysics, or Biological Structures and Processes. One counts 30 ECTS, the other 35 ECTS. The choice is fixed when registering for the first exam and cannot be changed afterwards.

name.zh-CN: 统计、深化模块与硕士论文
name.en: Statistics, advanced module and master thesis

ruleText.zh-CN: 统计与统计编程 5 ECTS（90 分钟笔试 + 练习作业），深化模块 20 ECTS，硕士论文 30 ECTS，合计 55 ECTS。
ruleText.en: Statistics and statistical programming 5 ECTS (90-minute written exam plus exercises), advanced module 20 ECTS, master thesis 30 ECTS, 55 ECTS in total.

ruleText.zh-CN: 硕士共需 120 ECTS，四个学期，每学期 30 ECTS，共 11 个模块。硕士论文占 30 ECTS。
ruleText.en: The master requires 120 ECTS across four semesters, 30 per semester, spread over 11 modules. The master thesis accounts for 30 ECTS.

ruleText.zh-CN: 基础免疫学 10 ECTS、基础免疫学实验课 10 ECTS、细胞与分子生物学 5 ECTS、感染病免疫学 10 ECTS、感染病免疫学实验课 10 ECTS，合计 45 ECTS。均在第一、二学期完成。
ruleText.en: Basic Immunology 10 ECTS, Basic Immunology Laboratory Course 10 ECTS, Cell and Molecular Biology 5 ECTS, Infectious Disease Immunology 10 ECTS, Infectious Disease Immunology Laboratory Course 10 ECTS, 45 ECTS in total. All completed in the first two semesters.

name.zh-CN: 临床免疫学与项目工作

ruleText.zh-CN: 临床免疫学 5 ECTS、实践项目工作（含国际实验室轮转）25 ECTS、项目工作研讨课、成为科学家 5 ECTS。项目工作与实验室轮转是精英项目的核心，含冬季学校、国际会议与学术规范训练。
ruleText.en: Clinical Immunology 5 ECTS, practical project work including international laboratory rotations 25 ECTS, seminar to project work, and Becoming a Scientist 5 ECTS. The project work and rotations are the core of the elite programme, including a winter school, international meetings and good scientific practice training.

ruleText.zh-CN: 软技能 10 ECTS，可从成像、生物信息学、动物学、基因工程、临床研究设计、语言课程中选择。硕士论文 30 ECTS，正文约 75 页，另需学术答辩。
ruleText.en: Softskills 10 ECTS, chosen from imaging, bioinformatics, animal sciences, genetic engineering, clinical study design, or language courses. Master thesis 30 ECTS, about 75 pages, plus an academic defence.
